It's great. The higher up you live, the better. I was on the 10th floor, and I could barely hear the daily street noise. Noise mostly comes from your neighbors. Cons? Probably the elevators in the morning stopping on every floor. Laundry rooms are usually busy, and if you're like me, you don't want to say hello to everyone you see in the building.
